[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2464420842]巨构兼容补丁

为什么做出这个模组？

很多人注意到，自2.2版本以来，灵能飞升远远不如基因和机械飞升。
一个是人口对资源的重要性，另一个是灵飞除了抽奖外，缺乏独特的游戏元素。

我想如果灵能帝国可以利用其人民的力量来干一些兄贵和罐头做不到的大事，那会怎么样？

------
它的作用是什么？
当你的物种显示灵能标志时，你就能获得施展灵能力量的权限。

获得条件有二：

1. 拥有“灵能理论”科技，并且主要物种有“灵能潜势”或“灵能”特质；

2. 统治者为“天选之人”。


[*]新资源：灵能，每月产生一定数量，用于施展能力。
你能持有的灵能数量很大程度上取决于灵能人口、相关岗位人口、统治者和技术。

[*]可施放28+15种能力。执行不同能力需要不同数量的灵能。其中几个有前置解锁条件。
未来可能更多，但不保证——力量需要有价值且有趣。

[*]瞎邒使用能力之前请三思。腐化随着灵能施放而增长。
唯一能削减它的力量是净化，你不会希望它脱离掌控。

[*]泽珞在本模组中扮演重要角色——既能降低能力的门槛，又能提高灵能人口的产出。

[*]如果“天选之人”担任统治者，可以为帝国贡献他们的力量。
这些能力为天选之人独有，只有在其帮助下才能进行。

[*]与虚境的某个实体缔结契约，你就能获得相关能力。

[*]增加10个新科技，3项法令，都与灵能有关。


------
注意事项

[*]在操作其它东西（如行星视图、指挥船只）时，避免使用灵能菜单——因为 UI mod 会一直检查 scope 是否为国家。
不会破坏mod，但会导致暂时失效。

[*]你可以拥有超过条形图显示上限的灵能（300）。

[*]蜂群，智械只要有灵能特质就可以使用相关功能，但你需要打其他实现前提的 mod。

[*]在AI上下了很大功夫，它们可以完美处理模组功能。

[*]AI可以通过本 mod 正常访问虚境。

[*]本 mod 注重具有灵能力量的物种，而不是新建筑、结构、武器或船只。

It's finally here, the main mod I've been working on from the original Teladi and Boron standalone shipsets I released this year and last year. This is still a WIP with many more things I want to do and add. Included, is pretty much every single ship from Teladi, Boron, Split, Paranid and Argon from X3 Albion Prelude. Not to mention, a few models made by the X3 modding community. 

Compatibility

NSC2 Seasons 5 & 6 Compatible
Just like my other mods, this mod is highly recommended to run with NSC2 and was built around it. However, if you insist on playing vanilla, this mod can be used on vanilla. But with a fraction of the amount of ships.

Other Mods
This mod should be compatible with pretty much every other mod. I'm sure it goes without saying to not run this with the Teladi or Boron shipsets. With this mod, they're redundant now anyway.

Report any compatibility issues and I'll look into it, but more than likely it's not going to be a problem with this mod unless they use the same graphical_cultures and species names or something. 



Features

Full Shipsets - includes all ship classes in NSC2 except the colossus. Some races still need the juggernaut model ported, will be done in future updates.

Stations - Includes station models for all main stations and starbase stages. More will be ported in future updates including models for defence platforms and megastructures. Lets not forget, X3 didn't have many racially different stations, eventually I'll port stations from X2 to make this so.

Soundtracks - What is an X3 mod without the music? Main music tracks added, more will be added in the future

Species - Includes species for the currently included races. Teladi, Boron, Split, Argon and Paranid. I've tried making the portraits look a bit better from the previous mods. Lets be honest, they're hard to blend into the stellaris theme so there's an available patch at the bottom of the page to replace them with vanilla portraits if you so wish. Full namelists and pre-scripted countries with personalities to suit will be introduced eventually. 

FAQ

Nothing shows up after installing the mod
More than likely the launcher. Sometimes it bugs out and never really reads the mod. Best thing to do is go into Documents/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris delete launcher-v1.sqlite and your mod folder. Then re-launch the game, redo your playlists and make sure to have the right playlist active with the mod added!

Guns shoot from same origin, centre of ship
Eventually I will add new origins. But this takes time for what it is. It's on the to do list, but it's toward the back of it. 

What about Terran/ATF?
Yep! Will be added in a future update (not a seperate mod)

How about all the other x universe races? Xenon, Kha'ak, Yaki, Pirates, Goners
I have plans for them all eventually. Kha'ak and pirates won't feature as a playable race however, but hopefully an end game crisis and marauders. Xenon, Yaki and Goners have more than enough to be fully playable however, with deep shipsets like the other races. 

Are you going to change the defence platforms/ion cannon?
Probably something that's higher up on my list of updates. So yes. I did try doing the Ion cannon on the Teladi shipset mod, but textures still need a lot more work.

Do I need NSC2 to run this? 
No, but you'll be taking advantage of a fraction of the content. This mod is based around NSC2, so you'll get a very limited amount of ships.

Contents

Animated Portrait Set
One set of fully animated portraits.
They twitch, and blink, and look around, and breathe, just like vanilla portraits.
The set comes with male and female variations, head variations, crest variations, partial and total synthetic evolution, and psionic evolution.
The base portrait is available for selection both in Aquatic and Arthopoid species class.
The synthetic and psionic variants can also be selected separately.

City Set
One custom city set to go with the portraits.

Personality Room
One custom personality room to go with the portraits.

Custom Trait
In order to better replicate the mechanics of the Seelikor's Empire, I've created a custom trait, Apex Predator. This is selectable on start, but I've set it to NOT be randomized (so you won't have random AI species spawn with it).
The trait significantly increases the power of land armies and the political power that your species has as Elites (since they're literal giant monsters), but it also greatly increases their food consumption, and makes them de facto unsuitable for any task that ISN'T being Elites (their happiness thanks at other social strata). This trait is also the opposite of Familial: the happiness of all Apex Predators is inversely proportional to their number. When you pick this trait, you will start as a ruling minority, with randomized slave species on your planet as intendured servants, chattel, and livestock. 
If the mechanics of Apex Predator are too much of a hassle, you can simply avoid the trait (modify the Dreadreef, or create your own separate custom empire); the AI will not use it unless you make it.

Custom Empire
The portrait set comes alongside a custom empire (the Dreadreef), which is paired with a custom name list (Seelikor), a custom star system (Blighted Light), and personalized diplomatic greetings and insults (Deep Terrors). If you want other custom empires of yours to use the same diplomatic phrases as the Dreadreef, select the custom empire, and then create your own by modifying it (it will preserve the flag).
Alternative, any xenophobe empire whose main species has the Apex Predator trait should also default to the same flavor.

If the empire is not appearing in your list, it's possible you're missing one DLC related to its basic traits. In the case of the Dreadreef, this is what you require:
Overlord DLC (Subterranean Origin and Cave Dweller Trait)
Aquatic DLC (Aquatic Trait and Shipset)
Apocalypse DLC (Barbaric Despoilers Civic)

If you wish to play the Empire as provided, but lack the necessary DLCs, you can go to your steam workshop folder, find this mod's folder, go into prescripted_countries, and remove and/or replace the DLC-locked features manually. Once you do, the Empire should appear.
Mind you, the mod as a whole does NOT require any DLC, only the custom empire (so portraits, city set, names, etc. will all always be available to you by default regardless).

Spawn Rate
The portraits come with a custom empire (which can spawn), but they themselves are set to NOT be used randomly by the AI.

Compatibility
Pretty much everything. No vanilla files have been altered, and the additions are purely graphical.

Known Issues
If you use the base set and go through a full synthetic evolution, the portraits will have a more limited diversity of looks (as compared to taking the machine portrait from the start). This couldn't be fixed without going into editing some vanilla files, which would have severely reduced compatibility.
Note that going full synthetic will default portraits to the vanilla class initially. Once you have completed the Ascension's situation, you'll be able to create a template of the species with the appropriate portrait.
